clusters.name: registry-baseline
clusters.executionModeRationale: This cluster defines the maintained-series baseline, feature-bookkeeping framing, and stale paste-burst disposition that every later cluster depends on.

clusters.name: documented-dot4-families
clusters.executionModeRationale: The .4 registry families still share the same ledger and focused guard file, so serial execution is safer than parallel edits that would compete on section numbering and verification-hook wording.

clusters.name: dot5-markers-and-registry
clusters.executionModeRationale: This cluster mixes wrapper docs with live upstream-canonical marker edits on the maintained .5 release line, including the coupled tool_lifecycle/multi_agents agent-name seams and resume_picker marker anchors, so it should remain serialized after the .4 ledger pass.

clusters.name: audit-and-ship-guidance
clusters.executionModeRationale: Final guard wiring and branch-target notes should only happen after the registry rows and source markers are settled, so the implementation guidance matches the finished ledger.
